title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Discount Rates Across the Portfolio
content:
Four discount percentages are carried by a Wanderlane Traveller Club tier, one for each of the product lines that reads them: the percentage discount on qualifying hotel rate plans, the percentage discount on qualifying car rental rate classes, the percentage discount on qualifying vacation packages, and the percentage discount on travel protection premiums.

| Tier | Hotel rate plans, per cent | Car rental rate classes, per cent | Vacation packages, per cent | Travel protection premiums, per cent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Wanderlane Silver | 2 | 3 | 2 | 0 |
| Wanderlane Gold | 4 | 5 | 3 | 5 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | 6 | 8 | 5 | 10 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | 8 | 10 | 7 | 15 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | 10 | 12 | 10 | 20 |

The four percentages are separate figures and are read one product at a time. All four stand together only at Wanderlane Blue, where each of them is 0. Elsewhere they part company: Wanderlane Silver carries 2 on hotel rate plans, 3 on car rental rate classes, 2 on vacation packages and 0 on travel protection premiums, so a Wanderlane Silver member holds a discount on three of the four and none on the fourth. At Wanderlane Ambassador the four stand at 10, 12, 10 and 20 in the same order.
